presentation_safe_policy.numeric_limits_basis: Normative no-added-rotation targets, NOT measured safe angles or provider controls.
presentation_safe_policy.arm_amplitude: FOREARM_WRIST_ONLY; keep shoulder at source position, gesture beside target without crossing it
presentation_safe_policy.head_turn: EYES_LEAD; small source-supported follow; preserve visible facial and posterior silhouette
presentation_safe_policy.wing_movement: PRESERVE_SOURCE_SILHOUETTE; no deliberate flutter or added lobes
presentation_safe_policy.camera: STATIC; a subtle path requires separate source evidence and approval
presentation_safe_policy.end_state: Source torso orientation; one overalls-defined lower silhouette, no posterior body; object fully legible
